question: Does the new hydrology-coupled conservative L0 core preserve or improve temporal OOF performance relative to the frozen OLD36 mainline benchmark?

candidates.OLD36: frozen 20260824_21 P1/P2 rolling temporal OOF generated with AdamW plus L-BFGS
candidates.L0: 20260824_27 no-multiyear-legacy conservative mineral plus lower-dissolved N states

fairness: identical audited observations and T1/T2/T3 rows
identical AdamW plus strong-Wolfe L-BFGS optimizer schedule
identical v_f, pathway contrast, C-Q hinge, station ridge and numerical tolerances
seven fitted parameters in both candidates
P1 determines process evidence; P2 is preservation evidence only
noninferiority: paired station-block bootstrap CI95 upper of delta station-macro log-RMSE < 0.005
delivery_bound_alignment: L0 log_alpha_contact lower bound is -9.21 so its minimum effective contact multiplier is approximately 1e-4, matching the OLD36 sigmoid-delivery lower scale; the original -4.605 preflight bound was rejected as an unfair truncation before scientific interpretation.
parameter_dependent_spinup_correction: The original run used Stage 27 alpha=1,beta=1 diagnostic initial states during fitted-alpha evaluation. A pre-final audit found material post-2016 effects. The corrected implementation solves the exact repeated-1961-1970 piecewise-affine mineral and lower-N equilibrium inside every objective evaluation, so each fold and parameter vector has a consistent pre-1961 state.

boundary_semantics.delivery_or_readout_boundary: Any fitted boundary in log_alpha_contact, beta_contact, delta_path, beta_low, beta_high or log_sigma is confounding and blocks Stage 28.
boundary_semantics.v_f_lower_boundary: v_f=0 is the exact nested no-aquatic-attenuation member. It is reported as aquatic_attenuation_not_supported and does not invalidate the terrestrial L0 comparison.
boundary_semantics.no_post_result_expansion: Neither v_f nor any other parameter bound may be expanded after observing the OOF result.

forbidden: temperature, WWTP, SAS or another N pool
